documents.title: Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported a strong financial performance for 2025-26, driven by high occupancy and increased average revenue per occupied bed. Operating income and EBITDA grew significantly, while the board approved the construction of a 300-bed paediatric hospital and highlighted major advancements in specialized medical technologies and infrastructure. Kovai Medical Center and Hospital Limited reported solid financial and operational performance for FY 2024-25, achieving an operating income of Rs. 1,37,111.30 lakhs and an EBITDA of Rs. 40,781.69 lakhs.

demand_outlook.claim: The year 2025-26 continued to exhibit good performance driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB.
demand_outlook.quote: The year 2025-26 continues to exhibit good performance, having posted a 16% growth in revenue against 12% in 2024-25, driven by strong occupancy and higher ARPOB (Average Revenue Per Occupied Bed).

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that global healthcare demand continues to rise, driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations.
demand_outlook.quote: As global healthcare demand continues to rise—driven by aging populations, rapid advancements in medical technology, and increasing patient expectations—healthcare providers are under mounting pressure to develop cutting-edge hospitals, clinics, and medical campuses within tighter budgets and accelerated timelines.

capex_expansion.claim: The board approved the construction of a 300-bed paediatric hospital at the main center premises.
capex_expansion.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: The Institute of Neuro Sciences & OPD Block was inaugurated with a capital investment of 120 Crore.
capex_expansion.quote: Representing a capital investment of ₹120 Crore, this state-of-the-art facility operates as a vertical hub of medical excellence.

capex_expansion.claim: The company invested 47 Crore in advanced oncology and diagnostics.
capex_expansion.quote: We launched Tamil Nadu’s first Varian ETHOS AI-powered Adaptive Radiation Therapy system, part of a ₹47 Crore investment in advanced oncology and diagnostics and continue to lead the state in performing CAR-T cell therapies.

capex_expansion.claim: Investment in equipment during the year 2025-26 amounts to Rs. 11,845.14 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2025-26 amounts to Rs. 11,845.14 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The hospital is a 2000-bed hospital and plans to add another 100 beds in the main campus.
capex_expansion.quote: Our Hospital is a 2000 bed hospital. We will add another 100 beds in the main campus.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.
capex_expansion.quote: In addition we are planning a 300-400 bed hospital in Chennai.

capex_expansion.claim: The outpatient block for the new Chennai hospital will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
capex_expansion.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

capex_expansion.claim: The company made a significant investment of Rs. 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024-25.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of its ongoing commitment to adopt cutting-edge medical technologies, your company made a significant investment of ₹ 496.00 Lakhs in advanced medical equipment during the year 2024–25.

capex_expansion.claim: Total investment in equipment during the year 2024-25 amounts to Rs. 3,358.36 Lakhs.
capex_expansion.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2024-25 amounts to ₹ 3,358.36 Lakhs.

capex_expansion.claim: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch have added cath lab and MRI facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The newly inaugurated super-speciality facilities at the Sulur branch of Kovai Medical Center now have added cath lab and MRI facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to launch an upcoming neurosciences center equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.
capex_expansion.quote: The upcoming neurosciences center will be the first of its kind in this region, equipped with state-of-the-art facilities.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing existing gaps in medical care within the region.
capex_expansion.quote: We are also focused on expanding the Department of Oncology and addressing any existing gaps in medical care within this region.

margins_costs.claim: The hospital posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29% and a sustained PAT margin of 15%.
margins_costs.quote: Your hospital has posted a robust EBITDA margin of 29%, which is excellent compared to the current industry standards, and has shown a sustained PAT (Profit After Tax) margin of 15%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the profit margin for the year was 15%.

capital_allocation.claim: The board recommended a dividend of 15 per share for the financial year 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Based on Company’s performance, the Board of Directors are pleased to recommend a dividend of ₹15/- per share (150%) for the Financial Year 2025-26 subject to the approval of the members.

capital_allocation.claim: The company did not propose to transfer any amount out of profit to reserves.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company does not propose to transfer any amount out of the profit to reserves.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors recommended a 100% dividend for the financial year.
The dividend on equity shares, if approved, would involve a cash outflow of Rs. 1,094.23 lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: The dividend on equity shares, if approved by the members would involve a cash outflow of ₹ 1,094.23 lakhs.

capital_allocation.claim: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to 5239.02 Lakhs.
capital_allocation.quote: Investment in equipment during the year 2023-24 amounts to ` 5239.02 Lakhs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges such as stringent regulatory compliance, seamless integration of advanced technologies, and uninterrupted operations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Constructing healthcare infrastructure presents unique challenges, including stringent regulatory compliance, seamless integration of advanced technologies, and the need for uninterrupted, round-the-clock operations.

management_commitments.claim: Construction work for the 300-bed paediatric hospital may commence during the second quarter of 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The board has approved for constructing 300 bed Paediatric Hospital at the main center premises and the work may commence during the second quarter 2026.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that the outpatient block in Chennai will be ready for operation by the end of the year.
management_commitments.quote: The OP block will be ready for operation by this year end.

management_commitments.claim: Dr. Nalla G Palaniswami was re-appointed as Managing Director for a period of five years with effect from 1st October, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: The Board in its meeting held on 25th May, 2024 had resolved to re-appoint Dr.Nalla G Palaniswami for a period of five years with effect from 01st October, 2024.

management_commitments.claim: Mrs. V. Bhuvaneshwari was re-appointed as an Independent Non-Executive Director for a second term of five consecutive years effective from 3rd September, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: be and is hereby re-appointed as an Independent Non-Executive Director of the Company to hold office for a second term of five consecutive years with effect from 3rd September, 2024

management_commitments.claim: Mr. Vasanth Kumar Venkatasamy was appointed as an Independent Director for a term of 5 consecutive years from 1st September, 2024 up to 31st August, 2029.
management_commitments.quote: be and is hereby appointed as an Independent Director of the Company, to hold office for a term of 5 (five) consecutive years, from 1st September, 2024 upto 31st August, 2029.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
